messages:
cheng: Heads-up — noticed the dashboard p99 dropped by ~200ms after the routing policy change but p95 went up ~120ms. Looks like the fallback path is skewing the middle percentiles. Anyone else see this?

nina: I saw that too. p99 drop makes sense if a small fraction of slow tails got moved off the main shard, but p95 increase is odd. do we have sample provenance for these points? :thinking_face:

alex: Quick hypothesis: fallback route has higher queueing variance but fewer super-outliers, so p99 is better but p50/p95 shift depending on weight. need breakdown by route.

sami: agree. can we run a slice: group by route and token_count_bucket and emit counts + p50/p95/p99? I can run a query if someone posts the query snippet.

cheng: thanks. nina, can you run? ideally include origin_tag (client vs proxy vs fallback). here's a starting query I used previously:

```
SELECT route, origin_tag, approx_quantiles(latency_ms, 0.5, 0.95, 0.99) AS p, count(*) AS cnt
FROM telemetry.ingress
WHERE service='inference' AND ts BETWEEN now() - interval '30 minutes' AND now()
GROUP BY route, origin_tag, token_count_bucket
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

nina: running now. this might be noisy — I'll also include raw sample counts and the tdigest vs raw quantile compare.

ops-bot: Query job 987553 started by nina. ETA ~45s.

nina: quick result summary: main-route: p50 85ms, p95 210ms, p99 820ms (cnt 18.2k). fallback-route: p50 120ms, p95 360ms, p99 420ms (cnt 2.7k). origin_tag shows 85% of fallback samples come from long-token prefix cohort.

alex: aha — fallback has fewer extreme outliers (so p99 lower) but a bulk shift upwards for mid percentiles. that matches the observed dashboard numbers.

janet (console): UX note — console currently shows only merged percentiles by endpoint; no breakdown by route/origin unless you toggle the provenance view. users might misread a drop in p99 as overall improvement. we should add a small provenance badge on the latency sparkline that shows fraction of samples from fallback vs primary.

cheng: +1 on provenance badge. also we should make the hover tooltip show route-split counts. right now hover only displays the merged quantiles.

sami: operationally, we might want a short-term fix: when fallback weight > X% for an endpoint, surface a yellow banner: "Observed fallback routing for this endpoint (Y% of samples). Percentiles may reflect mixed routes."

nina: created quick dashboard slice with route filter and posted link: https://console/redwood/dash/latency-split?slice=recent-fallback — it shows the distribution.

alex: long term, we should include sample-origin as part of the percentile contract: UI should support weighted vs per-route percentiles and make rollouts default to per-route comparisons. current rollouts assume merged percentiles which hides route-specific regressions.

janet (console): noted. I'll file a small product spec: (1) provenance badge + hover counts, (2) alerting rule when p95 increases on any single route by >10% vs baseline, (3) toggle to view per-route quantiles.

cheng: can we also add a telemetry flag in the API that tags requests served via fallback at ingestion time (token-level metadata)? makes backfills and alerts simpler.

nina: we already set header X-Route-Used but it gets dropped in some proxies. I'll trace the ingestion path. likely a header mapping issue in the gateway.

ops-bot: Query job 987553 completed. duration 42s.

alex: next steps: nina to confirm gateway preserves X-Route-Used for all traffic, janet to own console badge spec, sam to prototype banner for heavy-fallback endpoints. I'll open tasks in the eng-platform board.

cheng: thanks. small immediate tweak: Nina, can you post raw counts per route for 1h window so SRE can adjust autoscaling thresholds?

nina: posted counts: main-route 36,780, fallback-route 5,920, aux-route 340. attaching short CSV to the ticket.

janet (console): UX quibble — for rollouts, showing both merged and per-route deltas side-by-side would help PMs. otherwise they keep over-indexing on p99 and miss midtail regressions.

sami: agree. also add a note in rollout runbook: "If fallback_fraction > 5% inspect per-route p50/p95 before approving."

cheng: perfect. thanks everyone. tagging @sre for visibility. :thumbsup:
